newsitem.title: USA: Franklin Quest, Covey Leadership to merge.
newsitem.headline: Franklin Quest, Covey Leadership to merge.

text.p: Franklin Quest Co and Covey Leadership Center said Wednesday they had agreed to merge in a stock swap worth about $160 million.
Franklin Quest will issue stock in exchange for all of the stock of Covey, a leadership consulting firm whose products include books, seminars and corporate training programs.
The transaction will be accounted for as a pooling of interests, the companies said.
The merger, which has been approved by the boards of both companies, is subject to completion of due diligence and approval by shareholders of both companies.
It is anticipated the transaction will close before the end of May.
The combined enterprise will be known as Franklin Covey Co, with annual revenues in excess of $445 million. It will operate more than 100 retail stores.
Franklin is a provider of training seminars and the creator of the Franklin Day Planner.
